decisions.reason: The mitred lever family builds directly on the firm's core metal forming and finishing know-how and stayed visible on the website, so the firm can easily absorb any market feedback and refine it within its existing handle range.

Its promotion to a page of its own in 2024 shows growing commitment, and its multifunctional design fits the firm's ergonomic and barrier-free expertise, giving it strong related knowledge to develop the product further.

This standard lever handle line sits squarely within the firm's established competence and is still listed, so keeping it costs little and fits the coordinated product families, although the weak promotional evidence leaves some risk of pruning.

The collection won both the German Design Award and the iF Design Award and has a dedicated page in both years, which gives management clear external validation it can interpret and build on with its design expertise.
